messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Paging @oncall_jess — SEV2 alert for customer 'LedgerX' (single-tenant). Route /v1/chat/stream p99 > 6s, streaming stalls spiked. Immediate paging due to SLO breach.

oncall_jess: Acknowledged. I'm on it. What do we know about customer impact? Any user-facing errors or 5xxs?

cust-success-marta: LedgerX just messaged support — their checkout streaming stalls mid-token then hangs. Several customers getting timeouts. They're escalating.

sre-lina: Looking into observability now, give me ~30s.

eng-richard: Possible suspects: KV cache thrash on single-tenant, or long prefixes causing huge batch assembly. Also check continuous batching behavior.

obs-bot: Observability snapshot (last 15m): p95=1200ms, p99=6800ms, p99.9=12300ms. Streaming stalls: 240 in last 10m (baseline ~3/hr). 502 stream resets increased. Gateway CPU spiked to 98% for serving pool lp-dedicated-3.

sre-lina: Query I ran:
```nSELECT percentile(latency_ms, [95,99,99.9]) FROM requests WHERE customer='ledgerx' AND route='/v1/chat/stream' AND ts>now()-15m
```
Traces show long blocking at kv_cache:get and inside batch_assembler waiting for large prefixes.

oncall_jess: Quick mitigations proposal: 1) route LedgerX to a smaller fallback model 2) reduce their max_concurrency (throttle) 3) disable streaming for new sessions until stable. Which is fastest to reduce tail?

infra-ops-raj: We can flip routing to model-llama-7b-opt via route policy in ~30s. Preparing command.

eng-richard: If batch_assembler is overloaded, reduce max_batch and turn off continuous batching for that customer. That reduces queuing.

sre-lina: Recommend doing both: route -> fallback + set max_batch=1 + continuous_batch=false for ledgerx. I'll watch metrics.

oncall_jess: Do it. Raj apply routing; Richard apply batch policy. Confirm when live.

infra-ops-raj: Applying routing change now:
```nredwoodctl route update --customer ledgerx --model model-llama-7b-opt --policy immediate
```
Done — traffic shift starting, expect full shift in ~10s.

eng-richard: Patching batch policy on serving pool lp-dedicated-3:
```nPATCH /api/internal/policy/batch
{ "customer": "ledgerx", "max_batch": 1, "continuous_batch": false }
```
Deployed and rolling restart 3 pods (graceful). ETA ~40s.

obs-bot: Traffic shift observed. After change: p99 down to ~3.2s, streaming stalls down to 18 in last 10m. Gateway CPU back to ~70%.

cust-success-marta: LedgerX reports partial improvement; some sessions still see hangs on very long prompts. They want ETA for full fix.

sre-lina: Traces show a minority of requests with extremely long prefixes (>50k tokens) hitting swap and causing KV hot path to thrash. We should enforce prompt length cap per-customer.

oncall_jess: For immediate risk mitigation I'll throttle prompt length and keep the routing/batch changes. Applying now.

oncall_jess: Command:
```nredwoodctl quota set --customer ledgerx --max_prompt_tokens 16000
```
Done.

obs-bot: After throttle: p99 ~2.1s, streaming stalls 3 in last 10m, 502s gone. Metrics stabilized.

oncall_jess: Handing off to @sre-lina for postmortem and follow-ups. Handoff summary:
- Incident start (thread_ts): 1857772461
- Trigger: p99 > 6s for /v1/chat/stream (LedgerX, single-tenant)
- Immediate impact: checkout streams partial/hangs, user timeouts, customer-facing errors
- Root causes (initial): KV cache thrash + oversized prompt distribution + batch_assembler overload under high concurrency
- Mitigations applied: route LedgerX -> model-llama-7b-opt, set max_batch=1 and continuous_batch=false for ledgerx, set max_prompt_tokens=16000
- Customer notified and on-call with support (Marta)
- Current status: mitigated, service stable for customer
- Follow-ups: INF ticket to add per-customer batching limits, prompt guardrails, KV cache heatmap + eviction tuning, fallback automation (routing + batch adjustments)
- Postmortem ETA: 48h

sre-lina: Acknowledged. I'll own the postmortem and create INF-4721 assigned to eng-runtime/kv-team and eng-runtime/batching. Will ping owners and schedule RCA sync.

eng-richard: Quick action item: RFC for automated fallback policy from console so ops can run routing + batch changes faster. I'll file RFC today.

cust-success-marta: LedgerX very appreciative of the quick triage. They'll wait for the formal postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident severity set to SEV2 -> mitigated. Alerts suppressed.

oncall_jess: Closing my shift. Next oncall takeover at timestamp 1857773520. Handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
